pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Frase costs $49/month for Starter, $129/month for Professional, and $299/month for Scale with annual billing reducing each plan by 20%, bringing Starter to $39/month, Professional to $103/month, and Scale to $239/month… the older Solo/Basic/Team tiers are now Starter/Professional/Scale, and prices went up with the entry tier moving from $15 to $49."

nl.description: Frase helpt bij het onderzoeken van zoekintentie, het maken van contentbriefings en het schrijven en optimaliseren van artikelen voor Google en AI-zoekmachines. De oude, goedkope Solo-instap bestaat niet meer; het instapplan kost nu $49 per maand.
limitations: Instapprijs fors gestegen ten opzichte van het vroegere Solo-plan

en.tagline: SEO research and content briefs with AI
en.description: Frase helps research search intent, build content briefs and write and optimise articles for Google and AI search. The old low-cost Solo tier is gone; the entry plan now costs $49 per month.
bestFor: Content briefs based on competitor analysis
Agencies producing lots of SEO content
limitations: Entry price rose sharply compared with the former Solo plan
